channel.title: Paksh: Society
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: King Charles visits viral jacket potato van
item.description: King Charles visited the van of a viral jacket potato vendor, known as Spud Bros. He was offered a 'positive spud' but declined a jacket potato with cheese and beans. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US airports return to normal after weekend travel disruptions
item.description: US airports are returning to normal levels of operation following three days of significant flight delays and cancellations over the weekend. The disruptions caused widespread travel chaos. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shoppers Disagree on Bag Usage
item.description: Shoppers have differing views on bag usage, as indicated by a headline stating 'Shoppers bag to differ'. Further details on the specific nature of the disagreement or the context of this statement are not provided in the available coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi Releases Memoir 'Belonging', Cites Hurt Over Family Narratives
item.description: Sonia Gandhi released her memoir, titled 'Belonging', stating that a significant reason for writing it was her hurt over baseless narratives being spread about her family. She spoke about this during the book's release event. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: A powerful explosion was heard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, accompanied by smoke seen near the airport. Saudi Arabia intercepted missiles, which caused the explosion. The exact location of the explosion was not immediately clear. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un was seen with his daughter, Ju Ae, during a mountain outing where she was observed skiing. The event took place in North Korea. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: The Goa cabinet has approved four schemes aimed at preserving manuscripts and documenting oral history. The initiatives were sanctioned during a cabinet meeting. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Delhi government has approved an annual health cover of ₹10 lakh for transgender persons. This inclusion will be under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. The decision was made by the Delhi Cabinet. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Karnataka sees protests by private schools and farmers
item.description: In Karnataka, private school managements and staff protested demanding the implementation of the Old Pension Scheme (OPS) and the filling of vacant posts. Separately, farmers in the state protested seeking water for their chilli crops. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Prince William and Princess Catherine visited India, participating in events related to the Earthshot Prize. Princess Kate delivered a speech at an awards ceremony, hailing the winners of the Earthshot Prize. Their visit included… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
